name: Team Logo Car Door Projector Light (Dodgers)
invariants: Projected logo: the word Dodgers in blue flowing script, a white baseball with red stitches above the letter g, red speed lines trailing down-left from the ball and under the script
The logo reads left to right for a person standing outside the car facing the open door; never mirrored
The unit is a small black square box with a round lens, stuck under the inside door panel near its bottom edge, projecting a cone of white light down onto the ground
Unit holds three AA-size batteries in a tray inside; a red film covers the adhesive pad on its back

facts.value: Projects the team logo onto the ground below the open car door
Battery powered, batteries go into a tray inside the unit
Sticks to the door panel with an adhesive pad (peel the red backing, press on)
Install in 4 steps: insert batteries, prep the surface, remove backing, stick and close
Listing says: Install in 60 Seconds / 60-sec install
Listing says: No tools required / No tools needed
Listing says: Rep your team every time you step out.

inferred.value: LA baseball fans 20-45 who customize their car, cruise at night and show team pride in parking lots after games
Partner or family buying a small wow gift for a Dodgers fan (birthday, Christmas stocking)
Car mods seem to need wiring or a shop visit
A flex moment every time the door opens; friends notice the logo
Late October 2026: postseason / World Series window — fan pride and gifting are both high

unknown: how it turns on (door sensor type)

claims.text: Logo on the ground when you open the door

world.name: Dodgers (Los Angeles baseball)
cues: royal-blue baseball cap with white interlocking letters L and A on the front, flat brim
white baseball jersey with the word Dodgers in blue script across the chest and a red number below it, worn open over a plain black tee
a royal-blue rally towel hanging from the rear-view mirror
tall palm trees and a distant stadium glowing with white floodlights on the horizon
glossy black sedan with dark tinted windows

placement_checks: the unit is stuck under the inner door panel near its bottom edge, lens pointing down — never on the sill, the seat or the outer door skin
the logo lies on the ground directly below and just outside the open door edge, not under the seat or the wheel
the logo reads Dodgers in blue script, ball with red stitches above the g, red speed lines — never mirrored, never another word
logo visible only while the door is open; dark ground once the door is closed
the person stands on the ground outside the car or sits in the seat, never across the sill or through the door

key_trigger.what: the Dodgers logo blooming on the ground the instant the car door opens
key_trigger.proof_in_3s: the black door is already swinging open, the light cone snaps on and the Dodgers logo blooms sharp and glistening on wet asphalt
